'Departed unharmed, every one of them' gives ἀπαθεῖς ἀπαλλάττεσθαι μέχρις ἑνός ('to the last man'). 'Ps 103,33.34' etc. are edition lemmata. The rest (particles, γε, aspect, 'in us' for ἡμῖν) is style.
